$comment: The closed palette every command-center skin defines, in every mode it declares. Generated sections: tokens.required. A skin may add private tokens used only by its own skin.css.

groups.description: The three type families: interface text, headings and block names, figures and codes.

tokens.--chip: a chip or a pressed control's fill
tokens.--glow: the glow of a pressed control (transparent for none)

groups.description: The floors the model stands on.

tokens.--floor-edge: a floor's outline and layer names

groups.description: Zones on the Logical view and groups on the Physical view.

tokens.--plot: an owned zone with no tint
tokens.--grp-cloud-1: Physical group — the organization's cloud, tone 1
tokens.--grp-cloud-2: Physical group — the organization's cloud, tone 2
tokens.--grp-prem-1: Physical group — the organization's own datacenters, tone 1
tokens.--grp-ext-1: Physical group — a third party, tone 1
tokens.--grp-ext-2: Physical group — a third party, tone 2

tokens.--sev-context: context: an endpoint or zone a finding does not name

groups.description: Logical route families (the walkthrough's phase kinds).
Depth on the page: shadows under panels and what dims the page behind a dialog.

tokens.--shadow-ui: drop shadows under panels, cards and toasts
tokens.--scrim: the page behind a dialog, around the photo frame, gauge troughs

optional.--label-plate: a plated label's backing (falls back to --label-bg)
optional.--bg-core: the projector backdrop's centre — required when engine.projector
optional.--bg-mid: the projector backdrop's middle ring — required when engine.projector
optional.--accent-2: the projector's second ring and a neon panel's second accent (falls back to --floor-edge)

looks.neon: game ranks (LV S · A · B …), banner words, a typed codec
